dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: #How have you been recently {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: If you ever feel unwell, don't ignore it and soldier on, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Yeah, it's pretty nice. Great place to rest and recuperate.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: It's actually quite normal for Forest Rangers to rough it out in the wild sometimes.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: And during my wandering days, having a tent to keep the wind out was a luxury.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: But still... I do prefer places with plenty of vegetation. It's nice being surrounded by constant reminders of the temerity of life.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait... do you mean the "tenacity" of life...?

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Huh!? "T—Tenacity"? Wait, is it?

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, I only heard Master Tighnari say it once before... he said he likes living somewhere that is a testament to the... tenacity of life.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So shall I plant some more trees?

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: No need! It's great as it is.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: If you're gonna live somewhere for the long term, the most important thing to consider is how it makes you feel.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: I really like it here. Thank you so much for inviting me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Want to chat?

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Sounds good!

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: ...Um, sorry, I thought you were gonna go first.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: I don't have much experience in starting conversations... so I don't really know where to start.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't worry. As it happens, I've got something I wanted to tell you.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Oh... Sure, go ahead! I'm all ears.

choices.text: Amber told me a few things about you...

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Amber!? She mentioned me? What did she say? Wait, lemme grab my notebook, I need to write this down!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Heh, I don't know about flourishing — I've still got a long way to go... Was there anything else?

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Oh... I, um, I did my best...

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: I learned a few new words recently. I wanted to get the hang of them, so I tried to use them all in my letter.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: But if that made it too difficult to read, I guess I was getting ahead of myself.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: I need to take it slowly and use new words more carefully. Better to mix in a few new words with what I already know.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I can spell-check your letters for you.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Really? Wow, thanks! Oh, and in that case, I need to call you "Master," too!

choices.text: She said there were quite a few spelling mistakes...
Kaeya told me a few things about you...

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: K—Kaeya!? ...I'm sorry, I suddenly have a stomachache...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: He said you made quite a few spelling mistakes in your letter.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Oh, is that it? I was sure he'd gone and... Ahem, never mind.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Actually, I was wondering about inviting you to go camping with me.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: My mood's been pretty good these past few days, and I just finished an exam. Master Tighnari says I should take some time to relax.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: We should find a nice wide open place to enjoy the scenery, and bring some ingredients to cook over the campfire.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Um... I was thinking maybe we could leave today?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Today!?

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Um... well actually, I only handed in my exam paper so far. Master Tighnari said he'll mark it when he's got a spare moment...

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: But if I don't get a good mark, I'll have to start revising again right away.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: And you said you were up for it, so I didn't want to let this opportunity go by...

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Then again, now I think about it, even though we could find some ingredients on the ground, we'll need some time to think of a good location.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: And if we're going out into the wild, there's a whole lot of other things we need to prepare for, too...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: How about we just go camping here?

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Huh? Here? ...Actually, yeah, I never thought of that!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Plenty of open space, a great view, and no danger...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Consider it the trial run before we go camping for real.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Alright! Ah, this is such a good idea. You're so good at this kind of thing.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Wait! Are you sure Tubby won't mind?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Collei.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: #Good morning, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: I'm doing okay today. Here's hoping it continues.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good evening, Collei.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: #Have a good rest, {NICKNAME}, and let's hope tomorrow is another good day.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Hmm? Me? Oh... I'll hit the hay as soon as I'm done with my studying...

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Wow, what a great little cabin! I'm sure the time would just fly by if I did some reading here.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: But knowing me... I'd be bugging you for help every few seconds because there's so many words I don't know... That would definitely ruin the mood...

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Uh... I think I'll stick with books I've read before, then. Always helps to have a refresher.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Hmm... I see this hut is built from wooden stakes, lashed together nice and tight with a rope. It's really sturdy...

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Looks like you know what you're doing! I don't have anything else to add.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Next time we go camping, let's try and set up a tent that's just as strong as this!
